title: Ram 2500 and 3500 Engines by Year (1994–2026)
description: Every factory engine in the Dodge and Ram 2500 and 3500 pickups by year, 1994–2026: Magnum V8s and the V10, the 5.7 and 6.4 Hemis, and the 5.9 and 6.7 Cummins.
intro: Dodge's heavy-duty Ram 2500 and 3500 arrived with the 1994 redesign; they have been Rams since the 2011 model year. Chassis-cab ratings are not listed. The 5.2 V8 was offered only in the light-duty 2500.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The 5.2 and 5.9 Magnum V8s, the 8.0 V10, and the 5.9 Cummins: 12-valve to 1998, then the 24-valve.
The 5.7 Hemi, the 8.0 V10 for 2003, and the common-rail 5.9 Cummins, replaced by the 6.7 in 2007.
The 5.7 Hemi, the 6.4 Hemi from 2014, and the 6.7 Cummins in standard and High Output tunes.
The 6.4 Hemi and the 6.7 Cummins; from 2025 the High Output is the only diesel.
